plan.scope: post-hoc15 exposed T2 cases only; no fresh V6 inference
plan.normalization: first30 or all features available at that fit; frozen throughout confirmation and deployment
plan.inner_selection: minimum coordinate MSE on [half training end+2s,full training end), >=100 rows; fixed grid-order tie
plan.confirm: exact full export, [training end+2s,training end+60s); no postconfirmation refit
plan.prior0: fixed combined family, first30 normalization, latest3 strictly earlier same-layout histories; confirm[30,90),60 label seconds
plan.label_cost: all elapsed requested labels from30 throughconfirmationend, includingpurge; prior0cost60

interpretation: Half-window R2 uses each half's own target mean and variance. Its denominator changes with directional coverage; it is not equivalent to gain versus zero. Confirmation does not guarantee later accuracy. All label/normalizer boundaries are explicit.
data_policy: All fit metrics and failed choices retained; numeric models, per-bin samples, raw arrays and private paths excluded.
